seoTitle: Off Campus Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Off Campus test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Hannah, Garrett, Allie, Dean, Logan, Tucker or Jules. Get your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one with a plan for everything, the one who keeps the whole house fed, or the one who always knows the gossip first? Answer 12 everyday questions about friends, love and college life, and find out which Off Campus character you are.

characters.name: Hannah Wells
characters.title: The Quiet Talent
characters.summary: Smart, guarded and seriously talented. You don't let people in easily, but the ones who get there are lucky.
description: Like Hannah, you're driven and gifted. She's one of the top music students at Briar University, and the one person Garrett trusts to get him through his exams.
You've been through things you don't talk about lightly. Hannah carries real pain from her past, and she decides for herself when, and how, she opens up.
Your art is how you speak. Hannah turns what she's lived through into her songs, and when she finally sings her own story on stage, the whole room goes quiet.
characters.flaw: You keep your walls up long after it's safe to let them down.
characters.signature: Headphones on, a notebook full of lyrics and a sarcastic reply ready to go.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep their guard up no matter how nice you were

characters.name: Garrett Graham
characters.title: The Captain
characters.summary: Confident, driven and a natural leader, with a lot more going on under the surface than people assume.
description: Like Garrett, you're the one people follow. He's the captain of the Briar hockey team, already drafted by the Boston Bruins, and used to being the big man on campus.
But you're not afraid to ask for help when you really need it. Garrett's hockey career depended on passing one class, so he talked Hannah into tutoring him, with a deal of his own attached.
You're determined not to become the people who hurt you. Garrett's father controlled his life for years, and Garrett is fighting hard to be a better man than him.
characters.flaw: When someone hurts the people you love, your temper takes over.
characters.signature: A captain's jersey, a clever plan and a nickname he made up for you.
characters.clashReason: they'd always need to be the one in charge

characters.name: Allie Hayes
characters.title: The Ride-or-Die Best Friend
characters.summary: Witty, loyal and dramatic in the best way. You'd do anything for your friends, but your own feelings scare you.
description: Like Allie, you're the best friend everyone wishes they had. She's Hannah's roommate and biggest supporter, with a joke for every crisis.
You love a big moment. Allie is a theatre kid at heart, happiest when there's a show tune playing.
Commitment is where you get stuck. After her breakup with Sean, Allie kept things with Dean "casual" and secret, even when it was obviously much more than that.
characters.flaw: You're brave for everyone else and scared stiff for yourself.
characters.signature: A show tune, a best friend's hand to hold and a very bad idea at a party.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep insisting it's "just casual" when it clearly isn't

characters.name: Dean Di Laurentis
characters.title: The Charmer Who Falls Hard
characters.summary: Flirty, fun and much softer than he looks. You're the life of the party, until someone steals your heart.
description: Like Dean, you know how to have a good time. The Briar defenceman is confident, charming and never short of a party.
But when you fall, you fall completely. Dean noticed Allie at a party and was all in, even while she was trying to keep things casual.
You're more emotionally honest than people expect. Dean isn't afraid to want something real, and he struggles when the person he loves doesn't seem to want the same.
characters.flaw: You give your heart away before you know if it's safe.
characters.signature: A cheeky grin, a night out and a very hopeful text.
characters.clashReason: they'd flirt their way out of every serious conversation

characters.name: John Logan
characters.title: The Loyal Joker
characters.summary: Funny, easy-going and fiercely protective. You laugh a lot, but you've had to grow up faster than your friends.
description: Like Logan, you're the funny, easy-going one. He's Garrett's best friend on the Briar team, always ready with a sarcastic comment.
Your home life hasn't been easy. Logan's mother has struggled with addiction, and he looks out for his sibling Jules, even when they disagree about how much of a chance to give her.
When it counts, you step up. When Garrett walked away from hockey, Logan took over as captain.
characters.flaw: Once someone lets you down, it's very hard for you to trust them again.
characters.signature: A sarcastic grin, a family he'd do anything for and a jersey that's suddenly got a C on it.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a joke instead of telling you how they really feel

characters.name: John Tucker
characters.title: The Heart of the House
characters.summary: Warm, calm and always cooking. You look after everyone, and you never make a fuss about it.
description: Like Tucker, you're the one who keeps everyone going. He's a Briar forward, and the teammate who cooks for the whole house.
You're not the typical jock. Tucker is kind, steady and emotionally open, with plenty of boy-next-door charm.
You'd rather keep the peace than stir up drama. When the house is falling apart, Tucker is usually the calm one in the kitchen.
characters.flaw: You look after everyone else and forget about what you need.
characters.signature: An apron, a huge pan of breakfast and a full table.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you to calm down when you're not ready to

characters.name: Jules Logan
characters.title: The One Who Knows Everything
characters.summary: Sharp, nosy and secretly very caring. You always know the gossip first, and you'll always back your family.
description: Like Jules, you know everything that's going on, usually before anyone else. They run Fifth Line, the campus gossip account all about the hockey team.
You're more hopeful than you look. Jules wanted to give their mother another chance while she was in rehab, even when their brother Logan wasn't ready to.
And you're fiercely loyal. For all the teasing, Jules is always there when their brother really needs them.
characters.flaw: You can't resist telling a good story, even when it isn't yours to tell.
characters.signature: A phone full of screenshots and the first post about everything.
characters.clashReason: your secrets would end up online by breakfast

questions.text: Your friend has a huge crush but is too nervous to say a word. You...

options.text: Come up with a plan. A clever one
Hype them up, then physically push them across the room
Find out everything about the crush first
Invite them both round for dinner and let it happen naturally

questions.text: Your best friend's new partner is someone you know is bad news. You...

options.text: Tell your friend straight away. That's what best friends are for
Dig up proof before you say anything
Say how you feel once, then trust them to decide
Have a quiet word with the partner yourself

questions.text: It's Sunday and you've got nowhere to be. You...

options.text: Cook a massive brunch for the whole house
Write songs with your headphones on
Belt out show tunes while you clean
Sleep till noon, then go wherever the fun is

questions.text: You're about to fail a class you really need to pass. You...

options.text: Find the smartest person in the class and talk them into tutoring you
Put your headphones on and grind until it makes sense
Joke about failing, then quietly study at 2am
Try charming the professor. Worth a shot

questions.text: Someone says something cruel about a person you love. You...

options.text: Lose your temper, and regret it later
Walk away. You won't give them the reaction they want
Hit back with a comeback they'll think about for weeks
Step in front of them. Nobody talks about your people like that

questions.text: Something that was supposed to be casual starts to feel serious. You...

options.text: Panic, and insist it's still just casual
Admit you're falling for them, even if they're not there yet
Realise you were in deep long before you noticed
Take it slow and see where it goes

questions.text: You're signing up for a club this semester. You pick...

options.text: Musical theatre. Obviously
Cooking club, and you end up running it
Campus news. You always know what's going on first anyway
Anything where you get to sing

questions.text: Your group chat is exploding with drama. You're...

options.text: The one who started it, with screenshots
The one telling everyone to calm down
Adding jokes and fire emojis
Not reading it. You muted it hours ago

questions.text: A family member who's hurt you before says they've changed. You...

options.text: Keep your guard up. You've heard it before
Meet them halfway. They're trying
Cut them off. You're done hoping
Take your time. You'll decide when you're ready

questions.text: You play on a team that just lost a huge game. That night you...

options.text: Replay every mistake in your head. It feels like it's on you
Lighten the mood so nobody sulks
Make everyone food. Nobody should be sad and hungry
Go out anyway. A loss is still a night out

questions.text: Someone new moves into your shared house, and they're a nightmare. You...

options.text: Try to win them over with food
Make sarcastic comments until they get the message
Tell everyone exactly what they did
Invite them out. Maybe they just need a friend

questions.text: You're in college. You agreed to fake-date a friend so someone else would notice you. Weeks later, it doesn't feel fake any more. You...

options.text: Tell them straight. You're done pretending
Show them how you feel in a big, brave way you'd never have dared before
Call your best friend at 2am so you can overthink it together
Enjoy it and see what happens
